data.name: Feetball
data.detailed_description:
Feetball is a game re-imagined from the ground up, played out in first person on a tight,

enclosed arena pitch where physics rules everything. Nothing is automated or animation-locked.

Want to beat a defender, slip a pass into space, or smash one into the top corner? You earn it, foot

by foot, in the moment. Jump in with friends or squad up with players worldwide and scrap for every

single ball.

Master the Boot

Forget tapping a button to pass. In Feetball you move your feet yourself winding up, planting,

flicking, and striking through an active-foot system built around timing and touch. Keep the ball

up, twist past a marker, slide a through-ball, or let one fly. Because it's all simulated, the ball

never behaves the same way twice.

Team Up and Take Over

Feetball comes alive with a crew around you. Work the ball upfield, tee up your teammates, hold the

line together, and turn messy scrambles into goals that win matches. Fire off quick callouts to

coordinate, marshal the defense, or drop back and stand tall as the keeper. Whatever role you take,

you can be the one who decides it.

Make It Yours

Build your own Feetballer with a playful, characterful creator and take the pitch as nobody but you.

From custom practice drills to the competitive arena, Feetball will keep you mastering for the long haul.
